tools.name: feishu_get_user
tools.label: Feishu: Get User Info
tools.description: Get user information. If user_id is omitted, get the current user's information; otherwise, get the specified user's information. Returns details such as the user's name, avatar, email address, phone number, and department.

user_id.description: User ID (for example, ou_xxx). Omit it to get the current user's information.

tools.name: feishu_search_user
tools.label: Feishu: Search User
tools.description: Search for employees by matching a keyword against names, phone numbers, and email addresses. Returns matching employees with details such as name, department, and open_id.

query.description: Search keyword used to match user names (required).

page_size.description: Page size: the number of users returned per request (default: 20; maximum: 200).

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request. If the response contains page_token, pass that value to retrieve the next page.

tools.name: feishu_chat
tools.label: Feishu: Chat Management
tools.description: Manage Feishu group chats as the user. Actions: search (find chats by chat name or member) and get (retrieve details for a specific chat, including its name, description, avatar, owner, and permission settings).

query.description: Search keyword (required). Supports fuzzy matching against chat names and member names, including multilingual, Pinyin, and prefix matching.

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request.

tools.name: feishu_chat_members
tools.label: Feishu: Get Chat Members
tools.description: Get the member list of a specified group as the user. Returns member details such as ID and name. Bot members are not included.

chat_id.description: Chat ID (for example, oc_xxx). Use the feishu_chat_search tool to find it.

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request.

tools.name: feishu_im_user_message
tools.label: Feishu: IM User Message
tools.description:
Send and reply to Feishu IM messages as the user. **Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to send or reply as themselves. Otherwise, prefer the message system tool.**

Actions:
- send: Send a message to a direct or group chat. Use receive_id_type=open_id for direct messages and receive_id_type=chat_id for group messages.
- reply: Reply to a specified message_id, with optional thread replies (reply_in_thread=true).

**Important:** content must be a valid JSON string whose format matches msg_type. For the common text type, use '{"text":"Message content"}'.

**Safety:** Messages sent with this tool appear to come from the user. Before calling it, confirm both (1) the recipient, person or group, and (2) the exact message content. Never send a message without the user's explicit approval.

receive_id_type.description: Recipient ID type: open_id for a direct message (ou_xxx), or chat_id for a group chat (oc_xxx).

receive_id.description: Recipient ID matching receive_id_type. Use 'ou_xxx' for open_id or 'oc_xxx' for chat_id.

msg_type.description: Message type: text, post (rich text), image, file, interactive (message card), share_chat (chat card), share_user (user card), and others.

content.description: Message content as a JSON string, formatted for msg_type. Examples: text -> '{"text":"Hello"}'; image -> '{"image_key":"img_xxx"}'; share_chat -> '{"chat_id":"oc_xxx"}'; post -> '{"en_us":{"title":"Title","content":[[{"tag":"text","text":"Body"}]]}}'.

uuid.description: Idempotency key. The same uuid sends at most one message within one hour.

message_id.description: ID of the message to reply to (format: om_xxx).

msg_type.description: Message type: text, post (rich text), image, interactive (message card), and others.

content.description: Reply content as a JSON string, using the same format as send.content.

reply_in_thread.description: Whether to reply in a thread. If true, the reply appears in the message's thread; if false (default), it appears in the main chat timeline.

tools.name: feishu_im_user_fetch_resource
tools.label: Feishu: IM Fetch Resource
tools.description:
Download a file or image from a Feishu IM message to a local file **as the user**. User OAuth authorization is required.

Use this tool after listing or searching messages as the user when you have obtained a message_id and file_key and need to download the resource with the same user identity.
If message_id comes from the current conversation context, such as a message sent to the bot or a quoted message, use feishu_im_bot_image instead. That tool downloads as the bot and does not require user authorization.

Parameters:
- message_id: Message ID (om_xxx) from a message event or message list.
- file_key: Resource key from the message body. Use image_key (img_xxx) for images or file_key (file_xxx) for files.
- type: Use image for images, or file for files, audio, and video.

Files are saved automatically under /tmp/openclaw/. The returned saved_path is the actual local path.
Limits: maximum file size is 100 MB. Stickers, merged-forward messages, and resources embedded in cards are not supported.

message_id.description: Message ID (format: om_xxx) from a message event or message list.

file_key.description: Resource key from the message body: image_key (img_xxx) for an image message, or file_key (file_xxx) for a file message.

type.description: Resource type: image for an image message, or file for a file, audio, or video message.

tools.name: feishu_im_user_get_messages
tools.label: Feishu: Get IM Messages
tools.description:
Get message history from a group or direct chat **as the user**.

Usage:
- Use chat_id to get messages from a group or direct chat.
- Use open_id to get direct messages with a specified user; the tool resolves chat_id automatically.
- Filter by relative_time, such as today or last_3_days, or by start_time and end_time in ISO 8601 format.
- Paginate with page_size and page_token.

Parameter constraints:
- Provide exactly one of open_id and chat_id.
- Do not combine relative_time with start_time or end_time.
- page_size must be from 1 through 50 and defaults to 50.

Returns a message list. Each message includes fields such as message_id, msg_type, AI-readable content, sender, and create_time.

open_id.description: User open_id (ou_xxx) whose direct-message history to retrieve. Mutually exclusive with chat_id.

chat_id.description: Conversation ID (oc_xxx) for a direct or group chat. Mutually exclusive with open_id.

sort_rule.description: Sort order (default: create_time_desc, newest messages first).

page_token.description: Pagination token used to retrieve the next page.

relative_time.description: Relative time range: today, yesterday, day_before_yesterday, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, or last_{N}_{unit}, where unit is minutes, hours, or days. Mutually exclusive with start_time and end_time.

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format, for example 2026-02-27T00:00:00+08:00. Mutually exclusive with relative_time.

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 format, for example 2026-02-27T23:59:59+08:00. Mutually exclusive with relative_time.

tools.name: feishu_im_user_get_thread_messages
tools.label: Feishu: Get Thread Messages
tools.description:
Get messages from a thread **as the user**.

Usage:
- Use thread_id (omt_xxx) to get every message in the thread.
- Paginate with page_size and page_token.

Note: The Feishu API does not support time-range filters for thread messages.

The returned list has the same format as feishu_im_user_get_messages.

sort_rule.description: Sort order (default: create_time_desc, newest messages first).

page_token.description: Pagination token used to retrieve the next page.

tools.name: feishu_im_user_search_messages
tools.label: Feishu: Search Messages
tools.description:
Search Feishu messages across conversations **as the user**.

Usage:
- Search message content by keyword.
- Filter by sender, mentioned user, or message type.
- Filter by relative_time or by start_time and end_time.
- Limit the search to one conversation with chat_id.
- Paginate with page_size and page_token.

Parameter constraints:
- All parameters are optional, but provide at least one filter.
- Do not combine relative_time with start_time or end_time.
- page_size must be from 1 through 50 and defaults to 50.

Returns a message list. Each message includes fields such as message_id, msg_type, content, sender, and create_time.
Each message also includes chat_id, chat_type (p2p or group), and chat_name (the group name or direct-message peer's name).
Direct messages additionally include chat_partner with the peer's open_id and name.
Use chat_id and thread_id from a result with feishu_im_user_get_messages or feishu_im_user_get_thread_messages to inspect surrounding context.

query.description: Search keyword matched against message content. Use an empty string to skip content filtering.

sender_ids.description: List of sender open_ids. To find an open_id by user name, call the search_user tool first.

chat_id.description: Conversation ID (oc_xxx) used to limit the search.

message_type.description: Message type filter: file, image, or media. Omit it to search all types.

sender_type.description: Sender type: user, bot, or all (default: user).

relative_time.description: Relative time range: today, yesterday, day_before_yesterday, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, or last_{N}_{unit}, where unit is minutes, hours, or days. Mutually exclusive with start_time and end_time.

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format, for example 2026-02-27T00:00:00+08:00. Mutually exclusive with relative_time.

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 format, for example 2026-02-27T23:59:59+08:00. Mutually exclusive with relative_time.

page_token.description: Pagination token used to retrieve the next page.

tools.name: feishu_calendar_event
tools.label: Feishu Calendar Events
tools.description:
Manage Feishu calendar events **as the user**. Use this tool to view schedules, create or arrange meetings, update or delete events, search events, and respond to event invitations. Actions: create (create an event), list (list events in a time range and expand recurring events), get (get event details), patch (update an event), delete, search, reply (respond to an invitation), instances (list instances of a recurring event), and instance_view (list expanded events).

**Important:** create must include user_open_id, using SenderId from the message context in ou_xxx format. Without it, the event exists only on the app calendar and is invisible to the user. list uses the instance_view endpoint to expand recurring events. Its time range must not exceed 40 days, and it returns at most 1,000 instances. Time values use ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

start_time.description: Start time (required), in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

end_time.description: End time (required), in the same format as start_time. If the user does not specify a duration, default to one hour after start_time.

user_open_id.description: open_id of the user making the request (optional, but strongly recommended). Get it from SenderId in the message context; format: ou_xxx. Events are created on the app calendar, so this parameter must add the user as an attendee for the event to appear in the user's Feishu calendar.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID (optional; primary calendar used if omitted)

attendees.description: Attendee list (strongly recommended; without attendees, the event exists only on the app calendar and the user cannot see it). For type='user', set id to an open_id. For type='third_party', set id to an email address.

id.description: Attendee open_id, chat_id, resource_id, or email

vchat.description: Video-conference details. If omitted, a Feishu video meeting is created automatically when the first attendee is added.

vc_type.description: Video-conference type: vc (Feishu video meeting), third_party (external meeting link), or no_meeting. If omitted, a Feishu video meeting is created automatically when the first attendee is added.

icon_type.description: Icon type for an external video conference. Applies only when vc_type=third_party.

description.description: Display text for an external video conference. Applies only when vc_type=third_party.

meeting_url.description: External video-conference URL. Applies only when vc_type=third_party.

visibility.description: Event visibility: default (follow calendar permissions), public (details are public), or private (visible only to the owner). Default: default.

attendee_ability.description: Attendee permissions: none (cannot edit, invite, or view attendees), can_see_others, can_invite_others, or can_modify_event. Default: none.

free_busy_status.description: Free/busy status occupied by the event: busy or free. Default: busy.

latitude.description: Location latitude. Use GCJ-02 coordinates in mainland China and WGS84 elsewhere.

longitude.description: Location longitude. Use GCJ-02 coordinates in mainland China and WGS84 elsewhere.

tools.name: feishu_bitable_app_table
tools.label: Feishu Bitable Tables
tools.description:
Manage Feishu Bitable tables **as the user**. Use it to create, list, update, or batch-create tables.

Actions:
- create: Create a table. Optionally define fields at creation time with the fields array, or add them individually later.
- list: List all tables.
- patch: Update a table.
- batch_create: Create multiple tables.

Field-definition approaches:
1. When requirements are clear, define every field in create.table.fields to reduce API calls.
2. For exploratory work, start with the default table and modify fields incrementally with feishu_bitable_app_table_field. This is easier to adjust.

fields.description: Field list. Optional, but defining all fields when creating the table is strongly recommended to avoid adding them one by one. Omit it to create an empty table.

type.description: Field type: 1=text, 2=number, 3=single select, 4=multiple select, 5=date, 7=checkbox, 11=person, 13=phone, 15=URL, 17=attachment, 1001=created time, 1002=modified time, and others.

property.description: Field property configuration, which depends on the field type.

page_size.description: Number of items per page (default: 50; maximum: 100).

tables.description: Tables to create in the batch.

tools.name: feishu_bitable_app_table_record
tools.label: Feishu Bitable Records
tools.description:
Manage Feishu Bitable records (rows) **as the user**. Use it to create, query, update, delete, or search records.

Actions:
- create: Create one record with the fields object.
- batch_create: Create records with the records array.
- list: List or search records.
- update: Update one record.
- delete: Delete one record.
- batch_update: Update records in a batch.
- batch_delete: Delete records in a batch.

Parameter distinction:
- create uses a single fields object.
- batch_create uses a records array.

fields.description:
Fields for one record. Keys are field names; values depend on field type:
- Text: string
- Number: number
- Single select: string containing the option name
- Multiple select: string[] containing option names
- Date: number containing a millisecond timestamp, for example 1740441600000
- Checkbox: boolean
- Person: [{id: 'ou_xxx'}]
- Attachment: [{file_token: 'xxx'}]

create creates exactly one record. Use batch_create to create multiple records.

record_ids.description: Record IDs to delete, up to 500.

view_id.description: View ID. Optional, but recommended for better performance.

field_names.description: Field names to return. Omit it to return all fields.

filter.description: Structured filter object. Example: {conjunction: 'and', conditions: [{field_name: 'Status', operator: 'is', value: ['Active']}]}.

conjunction.description: Condition logic: and requires all conditions; or requires any condition.

value.description: Condition value. May be omitted for isEmpty and isNotEmpty.

desc.description: Whether to sort in descending order.

automatic_fields.description: Whether to return automatic fields (created_time, last_modified_time, created_by, and last_modified_by). Default: false.

page_size.description: Number of items per page (default: 50; maximum: 500).

tools.name: feishu_bitable_app_table_field
tools.label: Feishu Bitable Fields
tools.description: Manage Feishu Bitable fields (columns) **as the user**. Use it to create, list, update, or delete fields and change the table structure. Actions: create, list, update (including renaming with only field_name), and delete.

type.description: Field type: 1=text, 2=number, 3=single select, 4=multiple select, 5=date, 7=checkbox, 11=person, 13=phone, 15=URL, 17=attachment, 1001=created time, 1002=modified time, and others.

property.description: Field property configuration, depending on the type; for example, select fields need options and number fields need formatter. **Important:** For a URL field (type=15), omit this parameter entirely. Even an empty object causes URLFieldPropertyError.

page_size.description: Number of items per page (default: 50; maximum: 100).

field_name.description: Field name. Omit it to leave the name unchanged.

type.description: Field type. Omit it to retrieve the current type automatically. Values include 1=text, 2=number, 3=single select, 4=multiple select, 5=date, 7=checkbox, 11=person, 13=phone, 15=URL, and 17=attachment.

property.description: Field property configuration. Omit it to retrieve the current configuration automatically.

tools.name: feishu_bitable_app_table_view
tools.label: Feishu Bitable Views
tools.description: Manage Feishu Bitable views **as the user**. Use it to create, retrieve, list, or update views and change presentation modes. Actions: create, get, list, and patch.

page_size.description: Number of items per page (default: 50; maximum: 100).

tools.name: feishu_search_doc_wiki
tools.label: Feishu Document & Wiki Search
tools.description:
Search Feishu Drive documents and Wiki content together **as the user**. Action: search.

query is the search keyword. filter is optional. Without filter, the tool searches all documents and Wiki content; when provided, the same filter applies to both. Filters support document type, creator, creation time, open time, and other dimensions. Results include highlighted title and summary fragments, with matching keywords wrapped in <h> tags.

query.description: Search keyword (optional). Omit it or pass an empty string for an unqualified search, which can still use sorting and filters and defaults to recently viewed results.

filter.description: Optional search filters. Without them, search all documents and Wiki content. When provided, the same filters apply to both.

creator_ids.description: Creator OpenID list, up to 20 values.

doc_types.description: Document types: DOC, SHEET, BITABLE, MINDNOTE, FILE, WIKI, DOCX, FOLDER (Drive folder), CATALOG (Wiki 2.0 folder), SLIDES, or SHORTCUT.

only_title.description: Whether to search titles only. Default: false, which searches titles and body text.

start.description: Range start in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

end.description: Range end in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

sort_type.description: Sort order: EDIT_TIME for newest edits first (recommended), EDIT_TIME_ASC for oldest edits first, CREATE_TIME, OPEN_TIME, or DEFAULT_TYPE.

start.description: Range start in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

end.description: Range end in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format with a time zone, for example '2024-01-01T00:00:00+08:00'.

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request. When has_more is true, pass the returned page_token to retrieve the next page.

tools.name: feishu_drive_file
tools.label: Feishu Drive Files
tools.description:
Manage files in Feishu Drive **as the user**. Use it to list Drive files, get file metadata, copy, move, delete, upload, or download files. Do not use this tool for files attached to IM messages.

Actions:
- list: List files in a folder. Omit folder_token to list the root.
- get_meta: Get document metadata in batches with request_docs, for example [{doc_token: '...', doc_type: 'sheet'}].
- copy: Copy a file to a destination.
- move: Move a file to a folder.
- delete: Delete a file.
- upload: Upload a local file to Drive with file_path or Base64 data in file_content_base64.
- download: Download a file locally. With output_path, save it locally; otherwise, return Base64 content.

copy, move, and delete require file_token and type. get_meta uses request_docs.
For upload, prefer file_path, which reads the file and derives its name and size automatically. file_content_base64 is also supported but requires file_name and size.
For download, output_path may be a complete file path or a folder path combined with file_name. Without output_path, the tool returns Base64 content.

folder_token.description: Folder token (optional). Omit it or pass an empty string to list the user's Drive root. Root mode does not support pagination or shortcuts.

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request.

request_docs.description: Documents whose metadata to retrieve, up to 50. Example: [{doc_token: 'Z1FjxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxtnAc', doc_type: 'sheet'}].

doc_token.description: Document token from the browser URL, such as spreadsheet_token or doc_token.

doc_type.description: Document type: doc, sheet, file, bitable, docx, folder, mindnote, or slides.

folder_token.description: Destination folder token. Omit it to copy to the My Space root.

parent_node.description: Alias for folder_token. Retained for compatibility; prefer folder_token.
Parent-node token (optional). For explorer, use a folder token; for bitable, use app_token. Omit it or pass an empty string to upload to the Drive root.

file_path.description: Local file path. Provide exactly one of file_path and file_content_base64. Prefer this parameter; it reads the content and derives size and file name automatically.

file_content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Provide exactly one of file_path and file_content_base64. Use it when file_path is unavailable.

file_name.description: File name (optional). It is derived automatically from file_path. It is required with file_content_base64.

size.description: File size in bytes (optional). It is calculated automatically from file_path. It is required with file_content_base64.

output_path.description: Complete local destination path (optional), including file name and extension, for example '/tmp/file.pdf'. Omit it to return the file content as Base64.

tools.name: feishu_doc_comments
tools.label: Feishu: Doc Comments
tools.description: Manage comments on Feishu cloud documents **as the user**. Actions: list (comments with all replies), list_replies, create (whole-document comments with text, user mentions, and links), reply, and patch (resolve or reopen a comment). Wiki tokens are supported.

file_token.description: Cloud-document token or Wiki node token from a document URL. A Wiki token is resolved automatically to the document's obj_token.

file_type.description: Document type. wiki is resolved automatically to the actual document type, such as docx, sheet, or bitable.

is_whole.description: Whether to return only whole-document comments. Optional for action=list.

is_solved.description: Whether to return only resolved comments. Optional for action=list.

elements.description: Comment content elements, required for action=create and action=reply. Supported types are text, mention, and link.

open_id.description: open_id of the mentioned user, required when type=mention.

comment_id.description: Comment ID, required for action=list_replies, action=reply, and action=patch.

is_solved_value.description: Resolved state, required for action=patch: true resolves the comment and false reopens it.

tools.name: feishu_doc_media
tools.label: Feishu: Document Media
tools.description:
Manage document media **as the user**. Supports two actions: (1) insert, which appends a local image or file to a Feishu document and requires a document ID plus a local file path; and (2) download, which saves a document resource or whiteboard thumbnail locally and requires a resource token plus an output path.

insert accepts only local file paths. For images at a URL, use the <image url="..."/> syntax supported by create-doc and update-doc.

doc_id.description: Document ID or URL (required). document_id is extracted from a URL automatically.

file_path.description: Absolute local file path (required). Images may be jpg, png, gif, webp, and similar formats; files may use any format. Maximum size: 20 MB.

resource_token.description: Unique resource identifier: file_token for document media or whiteboard_id for a whiteboard.

resource_type.description: Resource type: media for document images, videos, files, and similar resources; or whiteboard for a whiteboard thumbnail.

output_path.description: Complete local destination path. It may include an extension, for example /tmp/image.png. If it has no extension, the system derives one from Content-Type.

tools.name: feishu_wiki_space
tools.label: Feishu Wiki Spaces
tools.description: Manage Feishu Wiki spaces. Use it to list spaces, get space details, or create a space. Actions: list, get, and create. Obtain space_id from a browser URL or the list action. A space is the base container of a knowledge base and holds a hierarchy of document nodes.

page_token.description: Pagination token. Omit it for the first request.

tools.name: feishu_wiki_space_node
tools.label: Feishu Wiki Space Nodes
tools.description: Manage Feishu Wiki nodes. Actions: list, get, create, move, and copy. Nodes are documents in a knowledge base, including doc, bitable, and sheet types. node_token uniquely identifies the Wiki node; obj_token identifies the underlying document. Use get to resolve a Wiki node_token to the underlying obj_token.

tools.name: feishu_sheet
tools.label: Feishu Spreadsheet
tools.description:
Create, read, write, search, and export Feishu spreadsheets **as the user**.

Feishu Sheets are similar to Excel or Google Sheets and are distinct from Bitable.

Every action except create accepts either url or spreadsheet_token and resolves it automatically. Wiki URLs are supported and resolve to spreadsheet tokens.

Actions:
- info: Get spreadsheet details and all worksheets in one call, replacing get_info plus list_sheets.
- read: Read data. Without range, read all data from the first worksheet.
- write: Overwrite data. This is a high-risk operation; use it carefully. Without range, write to the first worksheet starting at A1.
- append: Append rows after existing data.
- find: Find cells in a worksheet.
- create: Create a spreadsheet, optionally with headers and data in one call.
- export: Export as xlsx or csv. csv requires sheet_id.

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

range.description: Read range (optional): <sheetId>!A1:D10 or <sheetId>, where sheetId comes from info. Omit it to read all data from the first worksheet.

sheet_id.description: Worksheet ID (optional). Applies only when range is omitted. Omit it to use the first worksheet.

value_render_option.description: Value rendering: ToString (default), FormattedValue, Formula, or UnformattedValue.

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

range.description: Write range (optional): <sheetId>!A1:D10, where sheetId comes from info. Omit it to write to the first worksheet starting at A1.

sheet_id.description: Worksheet ID (optional). Applies only when range is omitted. Omit it to use the first worksheet.

values.description: Two-dimensional array, with one array per row. Example: [["Name","Age"],["Alice",25]].

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

range.description: Append range (optional), in the same format as write.range. Omit it to append after the data in the first worksheet.

sheet_id.description: Worksheet ID (optional). Applies only when range is omitted.

values.description: Two-dimensional array of rows to append.

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

sheet_id.description: Worksheet ID (required; obtain it with the info action).

find.description: Text or regular expression to find.

range.description: Search range in A1:D10 format without a sheetId prefix. Omit it to search the entire worksheet.

match_entire_cell.description: Whether to match the entire cell (default: false).

search_by_regex.description: Whether to interpret find as a regular expression (default: false).

folder_token.description: Folder token (optional). Omit it to create the spreadsheet in the My Space root.

headers.description: Header names (optional), for example ["Name", "Department", "Start date"]. When provided, they are written to the first row.

data.description: Initial rows (optional), written after the headers. Example: [["Alice", "Engineering", "2026-01-01"]].

url.description: Spreadsheet URL, for example https://xxx.feishu.cn/sheets/TOKEN or https://xxx.feishu.cn/wiki/TOKEN. Provide exactly one of url and spreadsheet_token.

spreadsheet_token.description: Spreadsheet token. Provide exactly one of spreadsheet_token and url.

output_path.description: Local destination path including the file name. Omit it to return only file metadata.

sheet_id.description: Worksheet ID. Required for CSV because CSV exports one worksheet at a time; optional for xlsx.

tools.name: feishu_im_bot_image
tools.label: Feishu: IM Bot Image Download
tools.description:
Download an image or file from a Feishu IM message to a local file **as the bot**.

Use this tool for resources in the current conversation context: messages sent directly to the bot, quoted messages, and images or files in group messages received by the bot. In other words, use it for message_id and image_key or file_key values present in the current context.
For a quoted message, extract message_id from [message_id=om_xxx] in the context; do not ask the user for it.

Files are saved automatically under /tmp/openclaw/. The returned saved_path is the actual local path.

message_id.description: Message ID in om_xxx format. For a quoted message, extract it from [message_id=om_xxx] in the context.

file_key.description: Resource key: image_key (img_xxx) for an image message or file_key (file_xxx) for a file message.

type.description: Resource type: image for an image message, or file for a file, audio, or video message.

tools.name: feishu_fetch_doc
tools.label: Feishu MCP: fetch-doc
tools.description: Fetch a Feishu cloud document and return its title and Markdown content. Supports pagination for large documents.

doc_id.description: Document ID or URL; URLs are parsed automatically.

offset.description: Character offset (optional; default: 0), used to paginate a large document.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return (optional). Use it only when the user explicitly asks for pagination.

tools.name: feishu_create_doc
tools.label: Feishu MCP: create-doc
tools.description: Create a cloud document from Markdown. Supports querying an asynchronous task_id.

wiki_node.description: Wiki node token or URL (optional). When provided, create the document under that node.

wiki_space.description: Wiki space ID (optional); my_library is a special supported value.

task_id.description: Asynchronous task ID. When provided, query the task status instead of creating a new document.

tools.name: feishu_update_doc
tools.label: Feishu MCP: update-doc
tools.description: Update a cloud document with overwrite, append, replace_range, replace_all, insert_before, insert_after, or delete_range. Supports querying an asynchronous task_id.

selection_with_ellipsis.description: Selection expression in the form beginning...ending. Provide exactly one of selection_with_ellipsis and selection_by_title.

selection_by_title.description: Heading selection, for example ## Section title. Provide exactly one of selection_by_title and selection_with_ellipsis.

task_id.description: Asynchronous task ID used to query task status.

tools.name: feishu_oauth
tools.label: Feishu OAuth
tools.description: Revoke Feishu user authorization. Call revoke only when the user explicitly asks to "revoke authorization", "cancel authorization", "sign out", or "clear authorization". Never call this tool when the user asks to "reauthorize", "start authorization", or "start again", or reports that authorization failed or expired. The system handles authorization automatically without manual intervention. Do not pass user_open_id; the system gets the current user from the message context.

parameters.description: Revoke Feishu user authorization. Call it only when the user explicitly asks to "revoke authorization", "cancel authorization", "sign out", or "clear authorization". Never call it when the user asks to "reauthorize", "start authorization", or "start again", or reports that authorization failed or expired. The system handles authorization automatically.

action.description: revoke: Remove the current user's saved authorization credentials.

tools.name: feishu_oauth_batch_auth
tools.label: Feishu: OAuth Batch Authorization
tools.description: Authorize all user permissions enabled for the Feishu app in one operation. Use only when the user explicitly asks to "authorize all permissions" or "authorize everything at once".

parameters.description: Authorize all user permissions enabled for the Feishu app in one operation using User Access Token scopes. Use only when the user explicitly asks to "authorize all permissions" or "complete authorization at once". Do not proactively recommend this tool.

tools.name: feishu_ask_user_question
tools.label: Ask User Question
tools.description: Ask the user a question via an interactive Feishu card. Returns immediately after sending the card. The user's answers will arrive as a new message in the conversation. Do NOT poll or re-call this tool — just wait for the response message. For selection questions, provide options (renders as dropdown). For free-text input, set options to an empty array.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user (1-6 questions)

question.description: The question to ask the user

header.description: Short label for the question (max 12 chars)

options.description: Available choices. Renders as a dropdown. Leave empty ([]) for free-text input — the user will see a text field instead.

description.description: Explanation of what this option means

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple options can be selected (ignored when options is empty)

selectStyle.description: For multi-select questions only: "dropdown" (default, compact multi-select dropdown) or "checkbox" (each option shown as a separate checkbox row, so the user can see all selected options at a glance before submitting). Ignored for single-select and free-text questions.
